name: Agents join a shared thread one by one
looks: A headline lands, then a shared log card shows a task header with a small row of helper badges. Below it a run of short join lines lands one at a time, each in its own colour, naming the helper that joined and what it picked up, the badge row above growing by one with each new line until a final schedule card resolves beneath it.
build: script-accent-underline for the headline; the join lines use list-stack-reveal's beat-by-beat landing but keep full colour and opacity once landed, since each is a distinct peer rather than a fading history. The badge row's count updates in lockstep with each new line.
sound: A soft blip per helper joining, pitched differently per helper, and a settle tone on the final schedule card.
prompt: Show several specialised helpers coordinating in one place: a shared log gains one short, colour-coded line per helper as each joins and states what it is handling, a badge row above growing to match, until the thread resolves into one finished plan.
